translation.title: Felbinac Cataplasm (Pap)
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for the analgesic and anti-inflammatory relief of osteoarthritis (degenerative arthritis), periarthritis of the shoulder, tendinitis and tenosynovitis, peritendinitis, epicondylitis of the humerus (such as tennis elbow), muscle pain, and swelling and pain after an injury.
translation.usage: Peel off the release liner and apply 1 cataplasm to the affected area twice a day.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine if you have experienced hypersensitivity to it, to its ingredients, or to other felbinac preparations, if you have or have had asthma triggered by aspirin or other non-steroidal anti-inflammatory analgesics, if you have experienced hives or acute rhinitis caused by aspirin or other non-steroidal anti-inflammatory analgesics, if you are pregnant, may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding, or on damaged skin or mucous membranes or areas with eczema or rash. Consult a doctor or pharmacist before use if you have bronchial asthma, if you have experienced hypersensitivity or an allergic reaction to propylene glycol, or if the user is a child. Itching, redness, flushing, dermatitis (rash, eczema), or contact dermatitis may occur occasionally, and irritation or blisters rarely. If any of these occur, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Store at room temperature.
